title: Damaged box with missing pieces took away from what would be a very nice product
text: Damaged box with missing pieces took away from what would be a very nice product. The box arrived damaged and opened at the corners resulting in missing components.  UPS left it at my front door, otherwise I likely would have refused it due to how badly damaged the box was.  I should have used my better judgement and  just shipped it back the following day, but I chose to attempt to put it together anyways (which is how I discovered missing parts).  The frame feels very strong once everything is bolted down.  The middle 2 legs were missing as were some of the bar endcaps so I imagine that the frame would feel even more solid with 2 additional middle legs.  Im shocked at  how weak the box was that was used to ship it in.  I imagine a long heavy box like that would be shipped standing up so the ends/corners of the box needs significant reinforcement to stand up to that type of abuse.

product_metadata.title: ZINUS SmartBase Compack Mattress Foundation / 14 Inch Metal Bed Frame / No Box Spring Needed / Sturdy Steel Slat Support, Narrow Twin, Black
features: TRADE UP TO GREAT MATTRESS SUPPORT - Upgrade your traditional bed frame and box spring for this simple-to-assemble and easy-to-maneuver mattress foundation for support that’s easy to fall asleep on.Maximum weight recommendation:1500 pounds

DURABILITY BUILT-IN - Made completely of durable steel, this reliable design features multiple points of contact with the floor and plastic caps to protect your floor; underbed clearance space of 13 inches adds maximum functionality

NO BOX SPRING NEEDED - Rest your latex, spring or memory foam mattress directly on top of the steel slatted platform; narrow twin, twin and twin XL sizes can support upto 750 lbs, while all other sizes support upto 1500 lbs
EASY ASSEMBLY - All tools, parts and instructions are expertly packed into one Compack shipping box for simple setup that takes less than an hour to complete
Worry-free 5 year warranty included; mattress sold separately
description: Trade in your box spring and traditional bed frame and trade up to the SmartBase® Compack® Mattress Foundation. This innovative foundation provides the even and sturdy surface of a box spring and even more stability than a traditional bed frame with its multiple support legs crafted from thick and durable steel. And if all that weren’t enough, you can also use this ingenious frame to store more under the bed than ever before with its 13 inches of clearance space. All steel parts, tools and step-by-step instructions arrive at your door in one slim and compact box, so maneuvering and setup take less than an hour. This rock-solid support system is also backed by our 5-year worry free warranty, so you can rest even easier. The SmartBase® is the headache-free way to do bedtime!
